name: rubiks-cube-solver
description: Camera-based Rubik's cube scanner and solver (React + TS + Tailwind + Express)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w cube-solver-server" "npm run dev -w cube-solver-client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w cube-solver-server && npm run build -w cube-solver-client
